prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were mostly too high compared to actual noise-corrected results, except for sign_in notification where the prediction was too low.
Sign-in notification was helpful, but with only 1 test, evidence is still thin.
No effect was seen for home new_flow changes across 2 tests.
No effect was seen for adoption redesign across 2 tests, though 1 test made adoption worse and was stopped early.
Evidence is still thin for adoption new_flow, choose_path reorder, finish new_screen, sign_in notification, and sign_in reorder.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: -5.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: -3.4% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- choose_path, reorder: +0.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -1.6% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- home, new_flow: -2.1% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, notification: +8.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -0.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 79.3%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 19.4%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, hint] Sign In Loading Fallback Hint: Adds a fallback hint on the sign-in screen if authentication fails to render quickly, offering a retry trigger. (why: Support received 2 emails reporting that the sign-in screen does not appear or stalls before loading.)
1: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Compact Grid Layout: Redesigns the pick_friend screen with a compact grid layout to showcase pet options clearly on one screen. (why: Adoption has the highest user drop-off rate (39.1% drop) with a high median duration of 89 seconds.)
2: [home, wait_info] Pet Rendering Live Progress Status: Displays live rendering step progress indicators and estimated time remaining on the waiting screen. (why: The home stage has a mean time of 2,336s and 3 support emails noted pets failing to show up on the desktop.)
3: [finish, hint] Desktop Taskbar Visibility Hint: Provides explicit hints on the home_intro screen explaining how to locate the pet tray icon and hotkeys. (why: Finish step has a 35.2% drop-off rate, and support received 3 tickets on how to control or unhide the pet.)
4: [choose_path, layout] Choose Path Centered Selection View: Switches choose_path screen layout to a centered style to reduce decision fatigue. (why: Choose path exhibits a large mean duration of 514s despite a fast 8s median, showing long-tail indecision.)
5: [choose_path, redesign] Story Screen Card Redesign: Redesigns the intro story screen into a card layout with animated pet highlights before path selection. (why: 23.8% of users drop off before completing choose_path, requiring a more engaging initial story entry.)
6: [sign_in, copy] Sign In Account Switch Copy: Updates sign_in screen headline and body copy to emphasize account persistence and pet data protection. (why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after re-signing into wrong accounts.)

scores.note: Addresses sign-in stall issues noted in 2 support emails; sign-in messaging interventions have shown positive precedent.
Adoption step has highest drop-off, but prior adoption redesigns consistently degraded conversion (-3.4%).
Home step has lower total drop-off; previous home flow changes showed no positive impact (-2.1%).
High drop-off step with direct support email validation; hint copy changes carry low implementation cost.
Targets long-tail duration in choose_path; minor layout adjustments show modest history of weak positive lift (+0.8%).
Full screen story redesigns carry high engineering cost and historical risk of negative conversion impact.
Strongest evidence combination with 8 support complaints; config-only text change in a proven positive step category.
